sections.text: مقدمة

This document outlines the 
equipment inspection I1, which must be performed on a monthly bases as 
indicated by M1 in the title block

المواصفات الفنية للرافعة المتنقلة 
السعة 32000 كجم، العرض 9300 مم، الوزن الإجمالي 9560 كجم، السرعة 20/5 م / دقيقة، القوة 
0.8/0.18 كيلو واط

The 
first draft is initiated , tested and approved by Eng. Abd El Mohsen Mohammed 
general manager of

Nag 
Hamady hyd. PS
احتياطات السلامة

A work permit must be issued and qualified maintenance staff should carry the 
 suitable safety category
Safety fence caution marks surrounding the work area is required

Wear the safety 
 and healthy equipment as safety helmet, safety shoes ...etc.
Stop the crane and switch off the power supply
